workshop.participant.description: Set up mod projects and collect SWE-Bench tasks
workshop.cmd.startProject: Scaffold a new mod project to farm sessions from
workshop.cmd.sweSession: Start collecting this session as a SWE-Bench task
workshop.cmd.note: Add a clarification to the session instruction
workshop.cmd.submit: Emit the task and open the review panel
workshop.cmd.status: Show what the active session has collected
episodes.participant.name: Modernity Data Collection
episodes.participant.description: Inspect and steer the active benchmark collection session
episodes.cmd.startProject: Create a mod project from Modernity's pinned NeoForge template
episodes.cmd.hint: Steer the agent and record the intervention as trace-correction data
episodes.config.enabled: Collect Data: capture ordinary Agent feature chats as benchmark episodes, including visible messages and tool inputs/results. Hidden model reasoning is never uploaded. `/swe-session` turns this on automatically for that task.
episodes.config.exportBundle: On Submit, write `instruction.md`, `golden.txt`, the sealed trace, and episode metadata into the project's `.modernity/episodes/<task id>` folder.
episodes.config.publishRepositoryPath: Local checkout of the Codimango SWE-Bench task repository. `/submit` verifies, copies, commits, and pushes the exact `passed_local` task at the repository root.
episodes.config.publishBranch: Branch used for SWE-Bench task publication. Publication is fast-forward-only and never creates merge commits.
episodes.config.webUrl: Base URL for the Modernity Project and Trace viewers. Defaults to gatewayUrl when empty.
episodes.config.gatewayUrl: Base URL for the Modernity inference gateway. Points to http://127.0.0.1:8000 in development and to the private gateway in packaged builds (e.g. https://modernity.dev).
episodes.config.chatCompletionsUrl: Full URL override for chat completions endpoint. If set, takes precedence over gatewayUrl.
episodes.config.modelsUrl: Full URL override for models endpoint. If set, takes precedence over gatewayUrl.
